svg.title: ECCM stave
svg.desc: The five stave lines of the ECCM mark as an element of their own, in pixels: one pixel thick on a seven pixel pitch, 60 wide, which is the mark's 1.5 on 7.375 at the size where a unit is a pixel. In a graphic it sits in the top right corner, flush to the right edge, with the padding from the top only (asked 2026-09-27: "treat 5 1px lines next to M also as separate element we can use in social media graphics etc in top right corner, edge to right side, padding from top"). Use it at its natural size or a whole multiple, so the lines stay whole pixels; drawn with currentColor, it takes the ink of the ground it sits on, and tools/mark.mjs writes the same lines at any width for a raster.
